title: Responsive Web Design - Media Queries
text:
Responsive Web Design
- Media Queries



CSS Media Queries

CSS media queries allow you to apply styles based on the characteristics of a
device or the environment displaying the web page.

CSS media queries are essential for creating responsive web pages.

The CSS
@media
rule
is used to add media queries to your style sheet.

Media Queries for User Preferences

Some users have motion sensitivity and prefer websites with less animation.

The

media feature lets you check if
a user has asked to reduce motion, such as animations or transitions. Use
